Käki.title: 9 Hours
Käki.about: These pieces are short excerpts of a 9 hour long piece of music we made at Sopenkorpi, Kesanto, 29th of June, 2018. Recordings are as they were, with the trees singing and what ever there was. This was a constant, liquid soundscape of music without any breaks from 21.00 to 06.00 a.m. Very few people attended, maybe mostly because people would not believe that we would actually play for 9 hours straight. This thing was interestingly draining physically but most of all psychologically. Right now I still exist in a state where I feel mostly nothing at all. Drained out, empty, neurotic in a way. The first part is recorded maybe around 00.00, the last part at 5 a.m. or something like that.
Käki.credits:
released July 1, 2018
Jere Kilpinen - scrap metal, guitar, synth, (bass on this recording), empty oil drum, saxophone, kantele, voice
Cédrik Bano - guitar, effects, sitraguitarthing

Unknown woman - kantele at some point
Eetu Floor - voice

Käki.title: After the End of the World
Käki.about: Oh, how beautifully it all came down. Radiant clouds in the horizon burned out thousands of years of civilization. Cries of the charred bodies, shadows in the doorway, Ghosts of consciousnesses slowly disappearing... Like an after image. Buried in dust broken meters buzz and the last of us are left to survive on scraps. The restless winds wander around the vast emptiness. Empty trains sail back and forth on their tracks. The electricity cracks before it goes out. At the edge of the world in a destroyed café, an old man playing on a broken piano, trying to gather the melodies that still remain, Like clinging on to old memories.. The piano is doomed.. The piano tuner also.. The pianist also.
Käki.credits:
released October 4, 2018
Cédrik Bano - guitar, noise
Jere Kilpinen - junk, percussion, saxophone, noise

Käki.title: .amlurKojeramKoras
Käki.about: This is Käki in a form that is one of my favorite things in the universe. A trio of silence. No thoughts, no restraints, just sounds that bend and melt into the forever and after, bending consciousness with it's mass, stopping time, disappearing into it. To me this is far more than "a band" with "albums" which have "songs". These are our blood. Snapshots of our consciousness. Time captured in place. They are recordings as they were, with all the hums and room noises there were. If you don't get it, you don't get it. That's ok. There's plenty of more other music for you. For those who truly feel this in their soul, we salute you. This thing is in four parts. Each name is a visual image, what is shown here is the phonetic representation of that name.
Käki.credits:
released December 30, 2018
Jere Kilpinen - guitar, junk metal, drums
Cédrik Bano - guitar, dronekone, effects
Terhi Eskelinen - voice

Käki.title: Amplified Silence
Käki.about:
Recorded 9th of February 2018, with one take by Martta Laine who also mixed it, mastered by Eetu Toikka. Album artwork by Jere Kilpinen. Download comes with a six page digipack artwork. The album artwork also worked as a a sole conceptual notation for the whole album. Our intention was to release this as a double CD, but since Käki has already in this short period of time progressed way beyond this sound, we don't feel like getting stuck with 100 CD's nobody wants to buy. They will happen if there is a demand.

Käki.title: Dada Flesh
Käki.about: This is not even music! Nothing is pre-meditated, nothing is given. Käki is where music crawls to die. This is Dada Flesh, chunks of sound and noise, born out of boredom, becoming bored of playing things you know instead of abandoning all you know, liberating oneself from what music "is" or what it "is supposed to be". This is just sound, art as a knife that turns against the one who wields it, this is stream of consciousness as it is, unaltered, unfiltered, whatever comes out, comes out.
Käki.credits:
released December 12, 2017
Jere Kilpinen, Cédrik Bano, Eetu Kilpinen, Juho Yrjölä

Käki.title: Katoa
Käki.about:
This is the First of Three. I made all of this alone, after spending four days in isolation. It took about 12 hours to create this album. This was the seed, the sprout that grew out of my hallucinations and showed me the way that I must follow. The bottom of the universe, the filth that has been drained, that lies there in the subconscious of mankind.
The download comes with the full album artwork.

trackinfo.title: Sonder
trackinfo.about: They all exist in their own reality that possibly never meets mine. We exist in our own isolated minds. Falling down like snow flakes, slow and heavy, going where ever the wind blows, eventually hitting the ground, finally melting into one big puddle of sleet and dirt. We are all separated for now, but we will all be alike in our demise.
trackinfo.credits: from Three Pieces For Three Guitars, Piano And Junk Metal, released December 23, 2017

trackinfo.title: Moving Shadows In The Dark Staircase
trackinfo.about: They are there. Lurking in the periphery of your vision. Not hiding. They seek attention. They grow taller and darker with your suspicion. They yearn to become seen, but they can't be seen, but they are there. Always there. You know it. Always there. Not hiding. Yearning to be seen. Seeking attention. Silently, in the dark.
trackinfo.credits: from Three Pieces For Three Guitars, Piano And Junk Metal, released December 23, 2017
